description: Agent + Frontend integration: modify recommendation_agent_v2.py to load RLHF policy with proper fallback chain (FIX-3), add RLHF types/functions to api.ts, add RLHF dashboard screen and star-rating in outfit cards to App.tsx. Depends on FEAT-003 (rlhf_policy_model module must exist).
steps: Modify backend/app/agents/recommendation_agent_v2.py: (1) Add 'import os' at top if not present. (2) Replace _load_sft_model() with _load_models() that: calls outfit_composition_sft_model.load_or_init(user_id) for sft_model; then checks os.environ.get('USE_RLHF_MODEL','false').lower()=='true'; if true, calls rlhf_policy_model.load_policy_model(user_id) — if returns non-None use as policy_model, if None log warning 'USE_RLHF_MODEL=true but no checkpoint found, falling back to SFT'; returns dict {'sft_model': sft_model, 'policy_model': policy_model_or_None, 'use_rlhf': bool}. (3) Rename _score_with_sft() to _score_items(). In _score_items(), check if models['use_rlhf'] and models['policy_model'] is not None: fetch embeddings for all items via vector_store.fetch_embeddings (skip missing, FIX-1), mean-pool per-item embeddings into outfit-level (512,) embedding, call policy_model.forward(emb_tensor) → scalar score, assign same score to all items in outfit, fill missing with 0.7. If not use_rlhf: use existing sft_model path unchanged. If neither available: return neutral 0.7 dict. (4) Update run() to call self._load_models(user_id) instead of self._load_sft_model(user_id), and pass returned dict to _score_items(). All existing behavior preserved when USE_RLHF_MODEL is unset.

Add to frontend/web/src/api.ts: interface RLHFFeedbackRequest, interface RLHFFeedbackResponse, interface RLHFStatsDayPoint, interface RLHFStats (with all fields from design: total_feedbacks, average_rating, rating_distribution, recent_feedbacks, most_liked_items, most_disliked_items, avg_rating_trend, most_liked_occasions, readiness_for_training). Functions: submitRLHFFeedback(payload: RLHFFeedbackRequest): Promise<RLHFFeedbackResponse> via api.post('/rlhf/feedback', payload); getRLHFStats(days=30, limit=10): Promise<RLHFStats> via api.get('/rlhf/stats?days=...&limit=...'); downloadRLHFExport(days: number, format: 'csv'|'json'): Promise<void> via api.get with responseType='blob' then programmatic anchor click download.

Modify frontend/web/src/App.tsx: (1) Add 'rlhf' to Screen type union. (2) Add nav item { id: 'rlhf', label: 'Suivi RLHF', icon: '◉', group: 'DÉCOUVRIR' } to NAV_ITEMS. (3) Add 'rlhf': { title: 'Tableau de bord RLHF', subtitle: 'Suis les retours et l\'évolution des recommandations.' } to SCREEN_COPY. (4) Add imports: getRLHFStats, RLHFStats, submitRLHFFeedback, downloadRLHFExport from './api'. (5) Add state: rlhfStats: RLHFStats|null (useState null), rlhfDays: number (useState 30). (6) Add useEffect scoped to screen==='rlhf': call getRLHFStats(rlhfDays).then(setRlhfStats).catch(reportError), also call setLoading(false). Add rlhfDays to dependency array. (7) Add RLHF dashboard JSX in the screen render switch/chain: show stats cards (total_feedbacks, average_rating formatted to 1 decimal, readiness badge), rating distribution as a simple table, avg_rating_trend as a list of date+rating rows, most_liked_items and most_disliked_items as two-column ul lists, period selector buttons (7j/30j/90j) that call setRlhfDays, export buttons calling downloadRLHFExport. No recharts — use only plain HTML elements and CSS.

In the outfits screen section of App.tsx (where outfits are mapped to cards), add a 5-star rating row under each outfit's explanation. Stars are buttons labeled 1-5 (or use ★ symbols). On click: setBusy('rlhf-rate:'+outfit.id), call submitRLHFFeedback({outfit_id: outfit.id, rating: starNumber}), then setNotice('Merci\u00a0! Ton avis améliore les recommandations.'), setBusy('') on both success and error. Disable stars while busy key matches. This is the primary feedback collection UI.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd backend && python -c "from app.agents.recommendation_agent_v2 import RecommendationAgentV2; print(\"OK\")"' succeeds.
With USE_RLHF_MODEL=false (default), recommendation_agent_v2 uses SFT model as before — no regression.
With USE_RLHF_MODEL=true and no checkpoint, recommendation_agent_v2 logs a warning and falls back to SFT — no crash.
frontend/web/src/api.ts exports RLHFFeedbackRequest, RLHFFeedbackResponse, RLHFStats, submitRLHFFeedback, getRLHFStats, downloadRLHFExport.
App.tsx Screen type includes 'rlhf' and NAV_ITEMS has the RLHF entry.
The outfits screen has a star-rating row per outfit wired to submitRLHFFeedback.
Running 'cd frontend/web && npm run build' exits 0 with no TypeScript errors.
verification: cd backend && python -c "from app.agents.recommendation_agent_v2 import RecommendationAgentV2; print('agent OK')"
cd frontend/web && npm run build 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
findings: Implemented FIX-3 fallback chain in recommendation_agent_v2.py (_load_models replaces _load_sft_model, _score_items added with RLHF → SFT → 0.7 neutral chain, FIX-1 skip-missing embeddings). Added all RLHF interfaces and functions to api.ts (RLHFFeedbackRequest, RLHFFeedbackResponse, RLHFStats, RLHFStatsDayPoint, submitRLHFFeedback, getRLHFStats, downloadRLHFExport). Updated App.tsx with rlhf Screen type, NAV_ITEMS entry, SCREEN_COPY entry, rlhfStats/rlhfDays state, useEffect for stats loading, RLHFDashboard component (plain HTML only, no recharts), and 5-star rating row per outfit card wired to submitRLHFFeedback. Also fixed pre-existing TS error (topbarWeather.city → removed, was blocking build).
